description: We are GADURA, a team of school friends passionate about space exploration, science, coding, and innovation. 🚀 We aim to work together in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 to solve real-world problems using creativity, teamwork, technology, and NASA's open data. We welcome our school friends who are curious, enthusiastic, and ready to learn, share ideas, and build innovative solutions together. 🌍🛰️
